# Build an AI meeting-notes assistant

## Decision

We should build an AI assistant that joins meetings, transcribes them, and
generates summaries with action items. This is a huge market and AI makes it
possible now in a way it wasn't before.

Everyone hates taking meeting notes, so the demand is obviously there. We can
use an LLM for the summarisation, which is basically a solved problem — it's
just prompt engineering at this point.

We'll differentiate on quality. Our summaries will be better than the
competition's because we'll invest in better prompts and fine-tuning. Once
people try ours they won't go back.

The plan is to ship an MVP in about two weeks and start onboarding users. Growth
should be viral since meetings involve multiple people, so every meeting is a
distribution channel. We can figure out monetisation once we have traction.

Team of two, both engineers. We're confident we can execute quickly.

## Assumptions

It'll work.
